name: software-project
description: Maintain project context, improve architecture, capture ideas, plan feature bundles, and coordinate reviewed implementation delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain context, improve architecture, and deliver planned software work.
interface.longDescription: Software Project provides five separate skills for durable project context, evidence-backed architecture improvement, Idea capture, Feature Spec planning, and reviewed implementation delivery. Project Context owns repository knowledge and ADR routing; Improve Codebase Architecture discovers and pressure-tests refactors; Idea, Plan, and Implement share one feature workflow contract while delegating GitHub transport to GitStack.
defaultPrompt: Use $software-project:project-context to maintain durable repository context and ADRs.
Use $software-project:improve-codebase-architecture to find and pressure-test architecture improvements.
Use $software-project:plan to turn an Idea into an agent-ready feature bundle.
